uiElement-pointerEvents.label: Pointer Events
uiElement-pointerEvents.tip: Whether to allow triggering mouse and touch events for this element

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.tip: Allows triggering pointer events for this element and its descendants

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.tip: Disables triggering pointer events for this element and its descendants

skipped.name: Skipped
skipped.tip: Disables triggering pointer events for this element but allows triggering pointer events for its descendants

uiElement-transform-align-left.tip:
$Left
Align the left edge of the element with the left edge of the container

uiElement-transform-align-center.tip:
$Center
Align the horizontal midpoint of the element with the horizontal midpoint of the container

uiElement-transform-align-right.tip:
$Right
Align the right edge of the element with the right edge of the container

uiElement-transform-align-top.tip:
$Top
Align the top edge of the element with the top edge of the container

uiElement-transform-align-middle.tip:
$Middle
Align the vertical midpoint of the element with the vertical midpoint of the container

uiElement-transform-align-bottom.tip:
$Bottom
Align the bottom edge of the element with the bottom edge of the container

uiElement-transform-anchorX.tip:
$Anchor X
The horizontal position of the element relative to the container's anchor point

uiElement-transform-anchorY.tip:
$Anchor Y
The vertical position of the element relative to the container's anchor point

uiElement-transform-x.tip:
$X
The horizontal position of the element within the container (in pixels)

uiElement-transform-x2.tip:
$X2
The horizontal position of the element within the container (as a percentage of container width)

uiElement-transform-y.tip:
$Y
The vertical position of the element within the container (in pixels)

uiElement-transform-y2.tip:
$Y2
The vertical position of the element within the container (as a percentage of container height)

uiElement-transform-width.tip:
$Width
The width of the element within the container (in pixels)

uiElement-transform-width2.tip:
$Width2
The width of the element within the container (as a percentage of container width)

uiElement-transform-height.tip:
$Height
The height of the element within the container (in pixels)

uiElement-transform-height2.tip:
$Height2
The height of the element within the container (as a percentage of container height)

uiElement-transform-rotation.tip:
$Rotation
The rotation angle of the element around the anchor point, 0 degrees = right, clockwise rotation

uiElement-transform-scaleX.tip:
$Scale X
The horizontal scaling factor of the element

uiElement-transform-scaleY.tip:
$Scale Y
The vertical scaling factor of the element

uiElement-transform-skewX.tip:
$Skew X
The horizontal skew factor of the element

uiElement-transform-skewY.tip:
$Skew Y
The vertical skew factor of the element

uiElement-transform-opacity.tip:
$Opacity
Adjusts the visibility of the element

uiElement-events.label: Events
uiElement-events.tip:
$Element Events
Visit"Event Triggered Light"to set the Element
$Options
Create: Event triggers when Element is initialized (executed once)
Autorun: Event triggers as soon as the Element appears (including after reading save data)
Mouse Down LB: Event triggers when left mouse button is pressed
Mouse Down RB: Event triggers when right mouse button is pressed
Mouse Down: Event triggers when ANY mouse button is pressed
Mouse Up LB: Event triggers when left mouse button is released
Mouse Up RB:  Event triggers when right mouse button is released
Mouse Up: Event triggers when ANY mouse button is released
Mouse Move: Event triggers when mouse moves within an Element
Mouse Enter: Event triggers when mouse enters an Element
Mouse Leave: Event triggers when mouse leaves an Element
Click: Event triggers when the mouse is clicked and released
Double Click: Event triggers when the mouse is clicked & released twice, triggering on the second release
Wheel: Event triggers when the mouse wheel is moved
Key Down: Event is triggered when a button Element is selected
Key Up: Event is triggered when a button Element is deselected
Input: Event triggers when when something is entered in a text box Element
Focus: Event is triggered when a text box enters the input state, or through a 'Set Focus' event command
Blur: Event triggers when a text box exits the input state, or through a 'Set Focus' event command
Event triggers just as (before) an Element is destroyed
Gamepad Button Press: Event triggers when a gamepad button is pressed 
Gamepad Button Release: Event triggers when a gamepad button is released
Left Stick Change: Event triggers when the left stick of the gamepad changes (moves)
Right Stick Change: Event triggers when the right stick of the gamepad changes (moves)
Custom: triggered using the 'Call Event' command
